name: Localhost
author: Emil Valdmanis
description: Discover local development servers, open them instantly, and send LAN-ready projects to your phone with a QR code.

barWidget.description: Live development servers, LAN reachability, QR sharing, and project controls.

schema.label: Show when no servers are running
schema.description: Keep the bar button visible for keyboard access and diagnostics.

schema.label: Include Docker
schema.description: Discover browser-ready ports published by running Docker and Compose services.

schema.label: Ignored ports
schema.description: Comma-separated ports or ranges, for example 3001,8000-8010.

schema.label: Always include ports
schema.description: Probe these ports even when the process is not recognized as a development server.

schema.label: Authorize LAN access for QR sharing
schema.description: Ask before creating a persistent UFW rule limited to the active interface, subnet, and port.
